. One Worm Bin is the reward for the Fish Farmers Bundle.
The Worm Bin automatically creates 4-5 pieces of bait every morning.

The resources needed to construct a Worm Bin will sell for 845g, without any professions. This means that it will take a Worm Bin about 42 days to pay for itself. If buying the materials (in Year 1), a single Worm Bin will instead cost 4,675g, and will take 267 days to pay for itself.
Produces Deluxe Bait on a regular basis. The worms are self-sufficient.
